Cluster 13 — occupancy at a sliding mass-coverage threshold

Each stop keeps the smallest set of HEALPix cells holding that fraction of cluster 13's tokens (the highest-density region); τ is the occupancy at the crossing. Sliding mass coverage rather than a fixed occupancy threshold is what makes one control work for both a territorial cluster (τ50≈1) and an itinerant one (τ50<0.1).
